rules.title: `{site.text.split(':')[0]}` is new in your theme and not yet accepted
rules.because: New tokens change what everyone may use.
rules.fix: plumber accept-decisions --why "…"

rules.title: Accepted token {entry.key} vanished from its source.
rules.because: Accepted tokens should stay in sync with the theme.
rules.fix: Run plumber ledger --prune after reviewing the removal.

rules.title: site.opaque ? `\`${site.token}\` is assembled at runtime, so Tailwind never generates it` : `\`${site.token}\` does nothing: no CSS is generated for it`
rules.because: site.opaque ? 'Tailwind only generates classes it can read as complete strings in your source.' : 'The style it was meant to apply is missing, and nothing warns you.'
rules.fix: site.opaque ? `Map each value to a complete class, e.g. { a: '${prefixText}a', b: '${prefixText}b' }.` : alternatives.length ? `Did you mean ${alternatives.map(name => `\`${name}\``).join(' or ')}?` : `Remove it, or define \`.${site.token}\` in a stylesheet.`

rules.title: `var({use.name})` is never defined{use.fallback === undefined ? '' : `, so it always uses \`${use.fallback}\``}
rules.because: The browser drops a declaration whose variable is undefined, so this {declaration.prop} is not applied.
rules.fix: ranked?.action?.startsWith('Did you mean') ? ranked.action : `Define ${use.name}, or use a token instead.`

rules.title: `{isClass(d) ? d.site.text : d.prop}` removes the focus outline on {owner}
rules.because: Keyboard users lose track of focus, and forced-colors mode shows nothing.
rules.fix: Restore an outline on :focus-visible.

rules.title: `{authored}` also applies on touch screens
rules.because: Touch can leave a hover style stuck after a tap.
rules.fix: Use `pointer-hover:` (or wrap the rule in @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)).

rules.title: `{isClass(d) ? d.site.text : d.prop}` is a physical side
rules.because: It doesn't mirror in right-to-left layouts.
rules.fix: Use `{logicalProperty(d.prop, value)}`.

rules.title: `{authored}` starts feedback slowly with ease-in
rules.because: Feedback to a person’s hand should begin immediately, without a slow start.
rules.fix: Use the project’s responsive easing decision instead of ease-in.

rules.title: `overflow-hidden` on {owner} creates a scroll container
rules.because: It breaks position: sticky inside and still allows script scrolling.
rules.fix: Use overflow-clip if nothing scrolls it.

rules.title: {owner} scrolls, and its scroll leaks to the page
rules.because: Reaching its edge scrolls the page behind it.
rules.fix: Add overscroll-contain.

rules.title: `{value}` has no safe-area fallback
rules.because: A safe-area environment variable needs a fallback so unavailable insets cannot invalidate the declaration.
rules.fix: Add a fallback: env(safe-area-inset-*, 0px), alongside the element’s own spacing.

rules.title: `{authored}` transitions every property
rules.because: Name the properties that transition so an unrelated change does not start animating.
rules.fix: Replace all with the specific properties that should transition.

rules.title: `{value}` uses vh, which jumps on mobile
rules.because: Mobile toolbars change the viewport height.
rules.fix: Use dvh for a changing viewport, svh for the smallest, lvh for the largest.

rules.title: `{d.site.text}` breaks {id}
rules.because: {habit.message}
rules.fix: {habit.message}

rules.title: This <{item.element.tag}> rebuilds {name} by hand (`{matches.join(', ')}`)
rules.because: A copy misses {name}'s states, focus ring and future fixes.
rules.fix: Use <{name}> from {source}.

rules.title: This change adds {summary.growth} ledger entries
rules.because: New exceptions and tokens are design decisions and need review.
rules.fix: strict ? 'Do not grow the ledger to pass an agent check; fix the sites or report NEEDS-DECISION.' : 'Review the added ledger line; debt may only shrink.'

rules.title: Exception `{key}` has no reason
rules.because: Every exception needs a reason a reviewer can check.
rules.fix: plumber accept {key} --why "…"

rules.title: Debt {entry.key} records {entryCount(entry)} sites; {current} remain.
rules.because: The ledger should record only remaining exceptions and debt.
rules.fix: Run plumber ledger --ratchet to shrink debt, or --prune to drop stale entries.

1.title: Align content, not boxes
1.why: The eye follows letters, not invisible boxes. A padded row sitting flush pushes its words in by its padding.
1.detail: Text and icons in a column share one left edge; a highlighted row bleeds out by its padding (-mx-3 px-3) so its background escapes the column and its text stays on the line.

2.title: Optical centre beats geometric centre
2.why: Visual mass, not bounding box, is what the eye centres.
2.detail: A play triangle, an arrow or a chevron centred by its box looks off; nudge it toward its heavy side (a play icon ~1–2px right).

3.title: Optical overshoot
3.why: A circle covers less of its box than a square.
3.detail: Round shapes must be a touch larger than square ones to look the same size.

4.title: Centre icons on cap height, not the line box
4.why: Line boxes include room for descenders, so line-box centring sits icons low.

5.title: Trim text's leading
5.why: A text box carries invisible half-leading above and below the letters.
5.detail: Padding of 16 around text looks like 20+ at the top; use text-box-trim or compensate.

6.title: Baseline alignment across columns
6.why: Tops of different sizes don't line up visually; baselines do.
6.detail: Label and value side by side share a baseline, not a top edge, at different sizes most of all.

7.title: Inner spacing ≤ outer spacing
7.why: Proximity is how people read grouping.
7.detail: The gap inside a group is smaller than the gap between groups.

8.title: Nested radius = outer radius − padding
8.why: Otherwise the curves aren't concentric and the corner looks pinched or bulged.

9.title: Equal padding isn't equal
9.why: Words are wide and short; a square box around them looks cramped.
9.detail: Text buttons want ~2:1 horizontal to vertical; icon buttons want equal.

10.title: The icon side gets less padding
10.why: An icon's whitespace is built into its glyph box.
10.detail: A button with a leading icon takes 2–4px off that side.

12.title: Vertical rhythm
12.why: Rhythm lets the eye predict and rest.
12.detail: Stacked sections space from a few repeated steps, consistently down the page.

13.title: 45–75 characters per line
13.why: Longer lines lose the return sweep; shorter ones chop the thought.

14.title: Line height shrinks as size grows
14.why: Big text with loose leading looks like separate lines.

15.title: Tighten tracking on large text, loosen it on small caps and labels
15.why: Large letters look loose; small capitals look cramped.

16.title: Tabular numbers for numbers that change or line up
16.why: Proportional digits jitter in counters and misalign in tables.

17.title: 2–3 weights, 2–3 text colours
17.why: Every extra level weakens the others.
17.detail: Hierarchy from contrast between few levels, not many levels.

18.title: No widows in headings
18.why: One word alone on the last line looks broken.

20.title: One light source
20.why: Mixed offsets look like a collage.
20.detail: All shadows fall the same way, usually down.

21.title: Shadows are tinted, not grey
21.why: A black shadow on a coloured ground looks dirty.

22.title: An elevation ladder
22.why: Inconsistent steps break the sense of depth.
22.detail: Higher means bigger and softer, in even steps.

23.title: Translucent borders on elevated surfaces
23.why: A solid grey border fights the shadow.

24.title: Perceptual contrast (APCA) for small text
24.why: WCAG 2 ratios mislead, most of all on dark themes.

25.title: No pure black or white for large areas

26.title: Disabled isn't just lower opacity
26.why: 40% text on a coloured button fails contrast and looks broken.

27.title: Hit targets ≥ 24px (44 on touch)
27.detail: even when the visual is smaller.

31.title: Press feedback within 100ms
31.why: Without it a press feels missed.

33.title: Content-driven sizes
33.why: Fixed sizes break with real content and translations.
33.detail: Buttons hug, columns fill, fixed widths only where things must align.

34.title: One avatar and icon size per list
34.why: 32 next to 36 looks like a mistake.

35.title: Truncate with intent:
35.why: Overflowing names break layouts or hide silently.
35.detail: min-width: 0, ellipsis, the full value on hover.

36.title: scrollbar-gutter: stable
36.why: Layout shouldn't jump when a scrollbar appears.

37.title: Never land on half pixels
37.why: Fractional transforms blur text and 1px lines.

38.title: Hairlines are 0.5px on retina
38.why: A 1px grey line is twice as heavy as meant on 2× screens.

39.title: Images get an inner outline
39.why: Stops light images bleeding into light pages, dark into dark.

40.title: Continuous corners (squircles)
40.why: Curvature that eases in feels softer at the same radius.

41.title: Concentric corners at every nesting level

42.title: Bold on hover must not shift layout
42.why: Weight changes width; the row jumps.
42.detail: Reserve the bold width (a hidden bold copy in ::after).

44.title: Light text on dark looks bolder
44.detail: Drop variable-font weight ~25–50 or add tracking in dark mode; antialiased smoothing for light-on-dark only.

45.title: Hanging punctuation
45.why: So letters, not marks, align with the column (optical alignment for prose).
45.detail: Opening quotes and bullets hang outside the text edge.

46.title: case feature for all-caps
46.why: Hyphens, parentheses and @ sit too low among capitals.

48.title: text-wrap: pretty for paragraphs, balance for headings
48.why: Different jobs: avoid orphans vs even lines.

49.title: Optical sizing on
49.why: Small text gets sturdier shapes, large text finer ones.
49.detail: font-optical-sizing: auto with an opsz axis.

50.title: Icon stroke follows text weight
50.why: Icons beside bold text look faint; big icons with small-icon strokes look heavy.
50.detail: and thins in proportion as the icon grows.

51.title: Layered shadows
51.why: One big blur is a smudge; layers read as ambient plus direct light.
51.detail: (Josh W. Comeau's shadows work): 3–5 stacked shadows, blur and offset growing, opacity falling.

52.title: Colour-matched shadows
52.detail: Tint with the surface hue, lower lightness, raise saturation.

53.title: Offset scales with elevation
53.why: A constant ratio is what makes a ladder feel physical.
53.detail: y-offset and blur together, one ratio across the ladder.

54.title: Dark mode elevates with light, not shadow
54.detail: Lighter raised surfaces, plus a 1px inset top highlight at low alpha.

55.title: Interpolate gradients in OKLCH/OKLab
55.why: sRGB interpolation goes grey between saturated colours.

56.title: Eased gradients for scrims
56.why: Linear fades show a hard edge; dark gradients band.

57.title: color-mix instead of opacity for text colour
57.why: Opacity varies with the ground and composites a layer.

59.title: Safe triangle for submenus
59.why: Otherwise crossing the next item closes it.
59.detail: Keep a submenu open while the pointer travels diagonally toward it.

60.title: Tooltip warm-up and cool-down
60.why: Exploring a toolbar shouldn't wait each time.
60.detail: First waits ~500ms; neighbours then open instantly until the pointer is away ~300ms.

61.title: Menus open on pointerdown, with press-drag-release selection

62.title: Don't animate frequent keyboard actions
62.why: A command palette opened 50 times a day should be instant.

63.title: Never scale from 0
63.why: From 0 it appears from nowhere; from the trigger it grows out of the button.
63.detail: start at 0.9–0.97 with opacity, transform-origin at the trigger.

64.title: Interruptible motion
64.why: A restarting keyframe on reverse feels broken.
64.detail: Transitions or springs that keep velocity when reversed.

65.title: Rubber-band at limits
65.why: A dead stop feels like a wall.

66.title: Spinners: delay ~150–300ms, then hold ≥ ~500ms
66.why: Fast loads shouldn't flash a spinner.

68.title: Exits faster than entrances
68.why: The user has already moved on.

70.title: Inputs ≥ 16px on iOS
70.why: Safari zooms the page on focus otherwise.

71.title: touch-action: manipulation
71.why: Removes the double-tap delay and grey flashes.
71.detail: and transparent tap highlights on custom buttons.

73.title: scroll-margin-top on anchor targets
73.why: A sticky header covers the heading you jumped to.

74.title: isolation: isolate instead of z-index wars
74.why: Components get their own stacking context.

75.title: Scroll shadows
75.why: Shows there's more without a scrollbar.
75.detail: where content is hidden (Lea Verou's background-attachment: local trick).

76.title: Truncate in the middle for paths and IDs

77.title: Skeletons match the final layout exactly
